Dusk Labs | Lead Software Engineer (Back-end, Rust, Fintech) | Remote (US time zone) | Full-time

Dusk Labs is a software development agency that helps early-stage companies kick-start their engineering operations, or mid-stage companies develop greenfield software projects.

We're looking for a lead software engineer to help build a high performance perpetual futures exchange. This role requires expertise in low-latency systems, distributed architectures, and financial infrastructure. As a lead engineer, you'll also need to understand delegation and mentorship.

For more details or to submit an application, check out the job listing at https://jobs.dusklabs.xyz/38548.
